stories.h: Microsoft posts $3.2B gain from Anthropic stake, OpenAI investment down
stories.s: The split shows how large AI bets can swing quarterly earnings and influence Microsoft’s strategy toward OpenAI and Anthropic, affecting its AI platform bets and shareholder returns.
b: Anthropic investment gain of $3.2 billion in the fiscal Q4 quarter, boosting diluted EPS by 0.33 and with the quarter’s EPS at $4.81
OpenAI investment marked down by about $600 million in the same quarter, reducing diluted EPS by about 0.07
For the full year, OpenAI investment generated a $5 billion gain and added about 0.67 to EPS
Microsoft owns about 27% of OpenAI and invested $5 billion in Anthropic in November 2025 as part of a circular agreement under which Anthropic would buy $30 billion of Azure services
body: Microsoft reported its fiscal fourth-quarter results, ending June 30, with revenue of about $90 billion and net income of roughly $35.8 billion for the quarter. In that period, the company disclosed a $3.2 billion gain from its investment in Anthropic, a gain that boosted diluted earnings per share by 33 cents. Microsoft’s quarter saw earnings per share of $4.81 as reported.
srcTitles: Microsoft logs $3.2B from Anthropic investment, but OpenAI was a mixed bag
In Q4, Microsoft's Anthropic investment saw a $3.2B gain, while its OpenAI investment was marked down ~$600M but has generated a $5B gain on a full-year basis (Julie Bort/TechCrunch)

stories.h: EU plans to designate OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Roblox as very large online platforms in August
stories.s: Regulators are set to impose tighter rules on two of the biggest AI-enabled services, potentially altering compliance costs and how they operate in the EU.
b: The European Commission plans to designate OpenAI's ChatGPT and Roblox as Very Large Online Platforms under the DSA
Designation could occur as soon as August
Designations would bring stricter scrutiny and monitoring requirements under the DSA
Bloomberg reports the plan; Gizmodo also notes the designation in its coverage
body: Bloomberg reports that the European Commission plans to designate OpenAI’s ChatGPT and the gaming company Roblox Corp. as Very Large Online Platforms under the Digital Services Act, with the designation happening as soon as August. The plan reflects the EU’s approach to targeting the largest digital services for enhanced oversight under the DSA.
srcTitles: Source: the European Commission plans to designate OpenAI's ChatGPT and Roblox as "very large online platforms" under the DSA as soon as August (Bloomberg)
